fields.System.Title: TRF-304 — Putaway transferred stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator at the destination, I want transferred stock to generate putaway
tasks like any other receipt, so that it does not sit on the dock as a special case.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a confirmed transfer receipt, then putaway tasks are created in the same
  • transaction, as in [INB-301](../INB/INB-301-generate-putaway-tasks.md).
  • - Given the tasks, then they use the same suggestion, override, and confirmation flow as
  • normal putaway.
  • - Given transferred stock, then it becomes available only once putaway is confirmed.
  • - Given quarantined or unexpected items from
  • [TRF-302](TRF-302-validate-against-dispatch.md), then their tasks target the quarantine
  • area.
  • - Given transferred stock still in receiving past the threshold, then it appears on the
  • stranded stock alert.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inbound, inventory |
| Tables | putaway_task, stock_balance |
| Risks | Stock stranded in destination receiving ([doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
